title: Community clinic appointment reminders
summary: A clinic network wants fewer missed appointments.

sections.title: Situation
sections.narrative:
A clinic network wants fewer missed appointments.

Today front-desk staff call patients one by one. The clinics want a reminder system that reaches people earlier, but they cannot assume every patient uses the mobile app or reads messages in English.

entries.text: keep reminders accessible across language and device differences
patients without smartphones must still receive reminders
the front desk cannot absorb unlimited manual callback work
SMS reminders with multilingual templates and call fallback
launch SMS reminders with multilingual templates and call fallback
launch SMS reminders without follow-up fallback

candidate_paths.title: Path A: inclusive reminder rollout
candidate_paths.narrative: This path automates the first reminder but keeps a manual safety net for patients who need it.
highlights: keep call fallback for high-risk or unreachable patients

candidate_paths.title: Path B: lean SMS rollout
candidate_paths.narrative: This path is operationally lighter than manual calling, but it is not ready if the clinics cannot guarantee callback coverage for people who miss or cannot read the first message.
highlights: use SMS as the main reminder channel
depend on current phone and consent records

candidate_paths.title: Path C: portal-only reminders
candidate_paths.narrative: This path is simple on paper, but it fails the accessibility and device-coverage standard.
highlights: use the app portal as the reminder channel
exclude patients who do not reliably use the portal
